text:
maya: Heads-up: multiple enterprise customers reporting p95 jump ~2x since last runtime rollout (v1.12.3) — support ticket #12345, #12346. Observed on canary and rolled to 30%. Any known changes that could affect tail latency?

beth-support: Ticket notes: p95 for short seqs (<64 tokens) ~120ms -> ~320ms. No QPS increase. I've attached request samples and timestamps.

sam-eng: Seeing same on our canary env. Started collecting perf traces. Quick snapshot from host runtime-8:
```
malloc_hold_ms: 3.6
gc_pause_ms: 1.2
heap_bytes: 1.8G -> 2.2G
```
Heap grows then stalls, correlates with p95 jumps.

devon-sre: Could be alloc-pacing change in scheduler. Recent PR bumped heap threshold and introduced delayed frees to reduce churn — might be causing slow-path mallocs under short requests.

lia-sre: deploy-bot shows 'v1.12.3' included commit `a1b2c3d` that touched allocator and scheduler. Also `grpc_keepalive` tweak around same time.

deploy-bot: Deployed runtime:v1.12.3 to canary (30%) at 2026-03-16T18:02:11Z

sam-eng: Repro steps for lab: run this against canary ingress with short prompt workload:
```
w rk -t12 -c300 -d45s --latency http://canary-internal/v1/generate -s scripts/short_prompt.lua
```
p95 reproducible in 20-30s.

beth-support: Customers gave example curl that spikes:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -X POST http://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":16}'
```

devon-sre: Mitigations:
- immediate: scale canary back to 0% / route traffic to v1.12.2
- medium: cherry-pick allocator revert (patch) and run canary
- longer: add malloc tracing and a perf counter to detect alloc stall tails

sam-eng: I'm starting a bisect: range a1b2c3d..f9e8d7c. Plan: git bisect with automated perf test harness (wrk) and check p95 threshold.
Commands:
```
git bisect start
git bisect bad a1b2c3d
git bisect good f9e8d7c
# script runs wrk and exits 0 if p95 < 200ms
```

lia-sre: Rolling canary back to 0% now. I'll also set a temporary routing rule to prefer runtime-version=v1.12.2 for affected customers.

deploy-bot: canary scaled to 0% at 2026-03-16T18:10:02Z

ops-bot: Alert created: INC-2026-0034 tracking p95 regression, assigned to @sam-eng and @devon-sre

maya: Thanks. Keep updates here. If bisect narrows to a single commit, we can push hotfix and notify support to close tickets with timeline.

sam-eng: Will post bisect results and attach perf flamegraphs. :eyes:
